remarks: Welcome to Rolling Ridge, one of Norwalk's premier communities! This spacious first floor J-Building unit features an open concept living space with an in-unit full size washer and full size dryer, a large bedroom with a window seat and incredible wall-to-wall closets! This unit is located close to all of the amenities that this complex has to offer, In-ground pool, paddle tennis court, scenic lake with fountains, picnic areas, fenced dog park and walking paths. Association fees include heat, hot water, and an in building personal storage unit. Conveniently located on a cul-de-sac with a private parking lot with an abundance of open parking for your guests. Enjoy shopping, restaurants and easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Metro North commuter train, I-95, Sono and surrounding Westport & Wilton.
